title: 12/3/2026 ZBA Cancellation
text: 54111 BROUGHTON RD MACOMB TOWNSHIP MICHIGAN 48042 MACOMB TOWNSHIP 586.992.0710 EXT. 7103 WWW.MACOMB-MI.GOV PLANDROPBOX@MACOMB-MI.GOV PLANNING AND ZONING DEPARTMENT ZONING BOARD OF APPEALS NOTICE OF MEETING CANCELLATION DECEMBER 3, 2026 Please be advised that the regular meeting of the Zoning Board of Appeals scheduled for December 3, 2026 at 6:30 p.m. held in the Board Room of Macomb Township Offices located at 54111 Broughton Road, Macomb, MI 48042 has been cancelled by the Chairman due to a lack of agenda items being submitted. Questions about meeting dates and times can be directed to (586) 992-0710 Ext. 7103. Aaron Tuckfield, Chairman Zoning Board of Appeals

Concerns of Zoning Board of Appeals Members, Director of Planning and Zoning, and Recording Secretary 9. Adjournment PUBLIC COMMENT/INPUT POLICY 1. Speakers shall address the Zoning Board of Appeals from the front table/lectern and begin by stating their name and address. 2. Speakers are encouraged to be as factual and brief as possible, and to restrict comments to the application and property under consideration. 3. Speakers shall address all comments and questions to the Chairperson. 4. Speakers are limited to three minutes each. The Chairperson has the discretion to extend the time. 5. Members of the audience sharing similar positions may caucus and select a single spokesperson, who may speak for up to five minutes. The Chairperson has the discretion to extend the time. 6. Speakers may address the Zoning Board of Appeals more than once, but subsequent comments must bring new information, correct the record, or raise new questions. 7. Members of the Zoning Board of Appeals may question any speaker to gather information. 8. Off-topic comments and interruptions from members of the audience shall be ruled out of order.
